quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Dusting but not moving someone's books — what does active preservation of an arrangement communicate?
quests.explanation: Preserving another person's arrangement without altering it is an act of quiet, sustained sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: She left all her books exactly where they were. I dusted them. I didn't move any of them.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A settlement sealed by silence — what does the layering of confidentiality agreements produce in an observer?
quests.explanation: An outcome that is legally hidden at every level suggests something worth hiding — producing rightful anger.
quests.textToSpeak: They settled the case out of court. The settlement included a non-disclosure agreement. The amount was not disclosed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Determines everything after this' — what does the weight of a single question's consequences produce?
quests.explanation: When one question carries every subsequent consequence, its weight creates acute nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I know it's just a question. But it's the question that determines everything after this.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two papers citing each other as support while contradicting each other — what does this circular logic produce?
quests.explanation: Two papers simultaneously contradicting and citing each other as support is a methodological puzzle that invites curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: Both organizations published conflicting findings from the same longitudinal study. Each paper cited the other as supporting evidence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'I think I needed that' — what does recognizing a change of perspective you needed produce?
quests.explanation: Recognizing that a change of perspective was exactly what was needed produces a reflective, quiet happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: The city looks different from here than from anywhere I've lived before. I think that's the point. I think I needed that.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The person responsible for a failure being hired to fix it and replace it — what does this appointment produce?
quests.explanation: Commissioning the original designer of a criticized building to design its own replacement is a surprising choice.
quests.textToSpeak: The architect who designed the city's most criticized building was then commissioned to redesign it after winning the contract for its replacement.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Six identical modules, six identical quizzes, all unrelated to reality — what has this training produced?
quests.explanation: Six repetitions of the same format covering irrelevant material is a compound cause of professional boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The training covered six competencies, each presented identically, each ending with a quiz identical to the last, each equally unrelated to the actual work.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Reframing scrutiny as a positive and naming the only thing that actually concerns you — what is this posture?
quests.explanation: Welcoming scrutiny while naming inaccuracy as the only real concern is a statement of deep professional confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: My work has been scrutinized twice before and came out stronger each time. Scrutiny doesn't concern me. Inaccuracy does.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A shortlist of formidable competitors any one of whom would have been obvious — what does this do to certainty?
quests.explanation: A shortlist of individually obvious competitors makes the outcome unpredictable and produces nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: There are more names on the shortlist than I expected. Any one of them would have been the obvious choice.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Plans for the anniversary replaced annually by quiet sitting — what does this recurring pattern reveal?
quests.explanation: A recurring gap between intended action and quiet sitting on an anniversary describes annual private sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: Every year I tell myself I'll do something meaningful on the anniversary and every year I end up just sitting quietly with it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A protective policy amended to exempt the exact parties it was designed to govern — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: A protection mechanism amended to protect those it was created to check is a cause of profound anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The policy meant to protect the most vulnerable was amended to exempt the parties responsible for the harm.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two national accounts of the same event with no acknowledgment of the other — what does this gap produce?
quests.explanation: Two nationally authoritative accounts of the same event with no shared reality is a historical curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The two countries have different names for the same historical event and neither history records the other's version.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'It's good' after false starts, doubts, and seventeen drafts — what does this simple two-word assessment carry?
quests.explanation: Two words carrying the weight of seventeen drafts and sustained doubt is a moment of quiet, earned happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: After everything — the false starts, the doubts, draft seventeen — I printed it out and read it straight through. It's good.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A complete life reset executed without any public transition — what does the manner of departure produce?
quests.explanation: An entirely silent, complete reset of a defining career with no transition signals produces genuine surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: She left the job that defined her for twenty years on a Tuesday with a single email, no forwarding address, and moved to another country.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Entirely outside my control' — what does this described loss of agency produce in a prepared person?
quests.explanation: Full preparation followed by complete loss of agency is one of the purest descriptions of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've done what I can do. What happens next is entirely outside my control. That is a very uncomfortable place to be.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A zero-budget pilot becoming a fully commissioned network series — what does this leap produce?
quests.explanation: A zero-budget production being commissioned for a full professional series is a cause of maximum creative excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The pilot episode we shot with no budget and a borrowed camera has been picked up for a full series on a real network.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An altered transcript caught by pre-existing audio copies — what does this discrepancy produce?
quests.explanation: A transcript contradicted by its own audio raises questions about who altered it and why — pure curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The transcript of the meeting was altered before circulation, but the audio version was already in three inboxes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A repeated reflex toward someone who is gone, followed every time by remembering — what does this loop describe?
quests.explanation: A repeated involuntary gesture toward an absent person, corrected every time, describes ongoing, active sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I still reach for my phone to send her something funny when I see it. Then I remember. Every time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Extensive findings released on a day designed to minimize their impact — what does this timing signal and produce?
quests.explanation: Deliberate timing to limit visibility of serious findings produces warranted anger at institutional bad faith.
quests.textToSpeak: The oversight body published its findings on a public holiday to minimize press coverage. The findings were extensive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Citing a revenue line against past critics who were wrong — what emotional position does this comparison take?
quests.explanation: Pointing to financial results against previous expert doubters is an expression of quietly vindicated confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: The critics said this market wasn't viable six years ago. I'd like them to see this revenue line.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Three days of workshopping producing no actual change to an eight-word statement — what did these days cost?
quests.explanation: Three days producing semantically identical output describes a purposeless process that breeds institutional boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: We spent three days workshopping our organizational purpose. We emerged with eight words that mean the same as the previous eight words.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A recovered deleted section contradicting the published conclusion — what does this discovery produce?
quests.explanation: Finding a deleted paragraph that contradicts the published conclusion raises significant questions of curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The deleted section of the report was recovered from a backup and contained a paragraph contradicting the report's main conclusion.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Stopping the count of bad days and recognizing it as recovery — what stage of healing does this describe?
quests.explanation: No longer counting difficult days and recognizing the change as recovery describes a quiet, earned happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: I realize I stopped counting the days I didn't enjoy. That is, I think, what recovery looks like.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: The harshest critic revealed to have been mentored by the target — what does this connection produce?
quests.explanation: A hidden personal relationship between a harshest critic and their target produces surprise at the dynamic.
quests.textToSpeak: The critic who wrote the most damaging review of the director's work was revealed to have been the director's former student.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Arriving to thank someone and finding out they died, not knowing how ill they were — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: Finding out someone died who had concealed the severity of their illness from you produces grief-layered sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I returned to thank the hospital team. Someone mentioned he'd passed the week before. He hadn't told me how serious it was.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Not knowing which outcome you want after entering yourself for something — what does this uncertainty signal?
quests.explanation: Ambivalence about a desired outcome after committing to it is a form of self-directed nervous uncertainty.
quests.textToSpeak: I submitted my name for consideration and now I genuinely don't know which outcome I'm hoping for.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Won't surprise me' based on having done more with less — what is this prediction's emotional basis?
quests.explanation: Prior achievement under harder conditions creating certainty about a better-resourced current attempt is confidence.
quests.textToSpeak: I built this once before with less knowledge and fewer resources. What I do with what I have now won't surprise me.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A governance framework with no input from those governed and no implementation period — what does this produce?
quests.explanation: A governing framework imposed without input or warning on the day before it applies produces justified anger.
quests.textToSpeak: The compliance framework was developed without input from the teams it governs and published the day before it took effect.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Consistent enough to suggest otherwise' — what does a pattern too uniform to be coincidental produce?
quests.explanation: A too-consistent pattern of identical stated reasons for departure over three years produces curiosity about the real cause.
quests.textToSpeak: Every senior departure from the company over three years cited personal reasons. The pattern is consistent enough to suggest otherwise.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Two hours of writing expressing twenty years of thinking — what does the fit of form to content produce?
quests.explanation: Finding exactly the right form for a long-held thought in exactly the right time produces deep satisfaction.
quests.textToSpeak: I wrote the essay in two hours, which is exactly how long it took to say something I'd been thinking for twenty years.
